name: Insource Co., Ltd.
summary: Insource Co., Ltd. provides various lecturer dispatch type training, open lecture, and other services in Japan. It offers on-site training; open seminars; educational; IT services; and engages other businesses, such as e-learning/video production, online seminar administration services, video training content, workshop and consulting services, DX promotion support, AI/ RPA introduction support, online seminar agency, and recruitment services. Insource Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
